title: Confident and Wrong: Structure Confidence Is a Poor Selection Filter for Protein Function
abstract: arXiv:2611.17391v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structure-guided protein design can generate plausible candidates, but structural confidence does not predict function. We trained a function-guided model on measured metal-binding affinity with protein sequence, ligand identity, and assay conditions, and used it to design rare earth element (REE) binding variants of lanmodulin, a lanthanide-binding protein with four EF-hand domains. We screened 297 designs from three strategies against terbium and dysprosium, adjacent lanthanides among the hardest REE pairs to separate. Selection on structural confidence inverted the outcome it was meant to improve. The Structure-Confidence-Selected panel carried the highest pTM, complex ipLDDT, and composite confidence scores, and expressed at 97%, yet only 16.7% of its designs bound terbium (95% CI 10.4 to 25.7), against 83.3% (74.6 to 89.5) for the function-guided panel, whose confidence scores were the lowest. The odds of binding differed 25-fold

translated_title: 自信却错误：结构置信度是蛋白质功能筛选的低效过滤器
translated_abstract: 结构引导的蛋白质设计可以生成看似合理的候选序列，但结构置信度并不能预测功能。我们在测量的金属结合亲和力数据上训练了一个功能引导模型，输入包括蛋白序列、配体身份和实验条件，并用它设计了稀土元素（REE）结合蛋白lanmodulin（一种具有四个EF-hand结构域的镧系结合蛋白）的结合变体。我们对来自三种策略的297个设计进行了筛选，测试其对铽和镝的结合能力——铽和镝是相邻的镧系元素，也是最难分离的稀土元素对之一。基于结构置信度的选择反而使其本应改善的结果发生了逆转。结构置信度筛选的组别拥有最高的pTM、复合物ipLDDT和综合置信度分数，且表达率达到97%，但其设计中仅有16.7%能结合铽（95% CI 10.4至25.7），而置信度分数最低的功能引导组别却有83.3%（74.6至89.5）的设计能结合铽。两者的结合几率相差25倍。
tldr: 研究表明结构置信度分数（如pTM、ipLDDT）无法预测蛋白质功能——基于结构置信度筛选的lanmodulin变体中仅16.7%能结合铽，而基于功能引导模型设计的变体结合率高达83.3%，两者结合几率相差25倍，说明功能引导模型才是设计稀土结合蛋白的有效筛选策略。
en_tdlr: Structure confidence scores are a poor selection filter for protein function: structure-confidence-selected lanmodulin designs achieved only 16.7% terbium binding versus 83.3% for function-guided designs—a 25-fold difference in binding odds—demonstrating that function-guided models, not structural confidence, should drive protein design selection.
